mapper.select: select * from px_todo_series where owner_id=#{owner} order by id desc limit 200
select id from px_todo_series where paused=false and id > #{after} order by id limit 100
select * from px_todo_series where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update px_todo_series set title=#{title},rule_type=#{ruleType},interval_days=#{intervalDays},week_days=#{weekDays},month_day=#{monthDay},zone_id=#{zoneId},local_time=#{localTime},start_date=#{startDate},end_date=#{endDate},next_date=#{nextDate},paused=#{paused},lead_minutes=#{leadMinutes},waiting_completion=#{waitingCompletion},revision=revision+1 where id=#{id} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: select todo_id from px_todo_occurrence where series_id=#{series} and occurrence_key=#{date}
select t.id from px_to_do t join px_todo_occurrence o on t.id=o.todo_id where o.series_id=#{series} and t.create_by=#{owner} and t.status=false
